name: Follow
overview: Following Jesus involves a deliberate commitment to deny oneself, take up the cross, and pursue Him wholeheartedly, as He calls His disciples to do (Mark 8:34). This path requires forsaking all else to obey and trust Him fully, recognizing Him as the light who leads out of darkness (Luke 5:11; John 8:12). True followers know His voice and walk in His footsteps, serving Him faithfully with the assurance of honor from the Father and the promise of eternal presence (John 10:4; John 12:26). The journey demands perseverance and joy in fulfilling the ministry entrusted by the Lord, prioritizing His gospel above personal life (Acts 20:24).
